name: to-c2sim-without-context
source: written for this repository from the schema; every C2SIM input and expected message validates against the schema (xmllint); expected output computed by the Python engine and reproduced by every engine
reference: C2SIM_SMX_LOX.xsd (OpenC2SIM/C2SIMArtifacts commit 947d8b5, Derived products/), MessageType, C2SIMHeaderType, ReportBodyType, PositionReportContentType, GeodeticCoordinateType, IsoDateTimeBaseType; the schema requires the header and report identifiers, which a canonical track does not carry: no kind qualifies
